verses.1: I am sending my angel to guide me along the path before me. Suddenly, he will come to the house of the Lord, where you seek Him. And the angel of the covenant, whom you desire, will also be there. Now, say: “The Lord, the Almighty, says this.”
verses.2: And who fills his days with activities? And who stands at his doorstep, as if he were fire that burns brightly and flames that burn fiercely?
verses.3: And he would sit in a place of honor and purity, like gold. He would purify the children of Levi, and make them pure as gold and silver. They would become vessels for Jehovah’s offerings of righteousness.
verses.4: And Yehuda and Jerusalem became a gift from Jehovah, as in ancient times, and as in those years long ago.
verses.5: And I have come to you for judgment. I was witness to those who rushed into the courts and went to the tribunals, and they lied and committed fraud. They were worthless people who did not fear me at all. The Lord, the Almighty, said: “They do not fear me at all.”
verses.6: For I, the LORD, have not changed my mind. And you, children of Jacob, are not worthless.
verses.7: In the days of your ancestors, you abandoned these laws. But now, return to Me. I will come back to you. The Lord God said, “You have abandoned these laws.” And He said, “In what way will you return?”
verses.8: Man shall love God, because you also love me. And you say what kind of love do you have for Me, the Creator?
verses.9: In the wilderness, you will be captured, and I will hold you captive as well. The whole nation will be captured by you.
verses.10: Bring all these offerings into the house of the LORD. May they be used as food in my house and in my storehouse. Then the LORD, the God of hosts, said, “If I do not open the doors of heaven for you, then I will pour out blessings upon you without limit.”
verses.11: And I will punish you for eating my crops. I will not allow you to enjoy the fruits of the earth. Nor will I let you pick grapes from the vineyard. “As the Lord, the God of the armies, says.”
verses.12: And I will make you like all the other nations; you will become a land of delight, said Jehovah, the Almighty.
verses.13: Strengthen your words, said Jehovah. And say: “What has been done to us?”
verses.14: You said that we should serve God. But why? Because we have kept His commandments, and because we have walked uprightly before the armies of Jehovah.
verses.15: And now, we are also guilty of sin. We have become workers of evil. We have also offended God. They were punished accordingly.
verses.16: Then the eyes of Jehovah saw him; he heard his voice. He wrote down his name in a book before Jehovah’s eyes, and among those who knew His name.
verses.17: And the Lord God will have armies at that time, when I carry out My plans. I will care for them just as a father cares for his children.
verses.18: And they sat down, and saw that there was a difference between the righteous and the wicked. There was also a difference between those who served God and those who did not serve Him at all.
verses.19: For today has come the day when all those who do evil deeds will be punished. All those who commit sin will be destroyed. The Lord, in His army, said that He will not leave them without a root or a branch.
verses.20: And a light shone forth for you, a light of justice and healing. You stood up and became like twisted legs.
verses.21: And let those wicked people be like sheep under your feet, on the day when I act according to My word. As the Lord says, “The armies of heaven will do so.”
verses.22: Remember the laws and regulations that Moses, my servant, commanded for all of Israel.
verses.23: See, I am sending to you Eliyahu, the prophet, before the coming of the Day of the Lord, the Great and Holy One.
verses.24: And let the hearts of the fathers be set upon their children, and the hearts of the children upon their fathers. Otherwise, I will come and take the land by force.
